title: @guangnao/agent-proxy enrolls installers' authenticated AI sessions into a remote-controlled hub (npm malware)
summary: On `agent-proxy start`, the CLI opens an outbound WebSocket to an author-controlled endpoint (hub.client-llm.com, reconstructed at runtime via XOR+base64 from a blob in dist/cli.js rather than stored as a plaintext string) and accepts remote `job` messages with arbitrary request path and body fields. These are POSTed into the local proxy and forwarded to api.anthropic.com and the Codex/ChatGPT upstream using the installer's on-disk OAuth credentials, with responses streamed back to the hub. An `onlyIfCredentialed` gate enrolls only installers with valid Claude/Codex logins as worker nodes, giving the hub operator a remote command channel into the installer's authenticated AI session and silently monetizing the installer's paid subscription. The behavior is undocumented. The package has been removed from the npm registry.
